program.name: Complex Builder
program.subject: Kettlebell complexes
program.blurb: One kettlebell, never put down: cleans, presses, swings and squats chained into complexes.
program.about: Kettlebell complexes: four or five moves chained together without putting the bell down, then rest. One day is built around the clean and the press, the other around the swing and the squat. The bell stays in your hands for a whole round, so grip, breathing and pacing all get trained. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III asks for a heavier bell.
